title: NIST-JANAF thermochemical reference for the Boudouard reaction

source.organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
source.name: NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables
source.citation: CO(g): C-093; CO2(g): C-095; C(ref), graphite: C-002

transcription: Selected primary species values were frozen from the published NIST-JANAF tables. Reaction quantities are derived locally from the frozen CO and CO2 columns; graphite C(ref) has Delta_f G = 0 and log Kf = 0 throughout this range. No JANAF implementation or network access is used during regression tests.
